operativeProvisions.s2: Manufactured products covered only when nature/processing may create pest-introduction/spread risk. Living plants distinguished. Regulated articles risk-qualified.
operativeProvisions.s2(2): Definitions shall be interpreted in accordance with IPPC ISPM 5 Glossary, as amended.
operativeProvisions.s14: Measures must harmonise with international standards, use science/risk analysis and be proportional to risk.
operativeProvisions.s18: Permit and required original phyto/other documents apply to defined plants/products/regulated articles. Local requirements must apply to regulated pests and rest on PRA or international standards; subsection8 allows prescribed permit-free goods.
operativeProvisions.s19: Permit application triggers concern quarantine-pest origins, post-entry quarantine, prescribed end use/research, humanitarian emergency, traceability or determined risk.
operativeProvisions.s20: Advance notification applies to regulated articles, not every food.
operativeProvisions.s27: Postal/courier officers hold defined regulated articles for inspection.
operativeProvisions.s66: Repeals Cap.268 (2007) and Cap.266A; expressly saves subsidiary Cap.266A instruments in conforming form.
